description: Use this when the user wants a currency converter or the currency exchange rate today, for example to convert usd to eur, euro to dollar, or the rate on date for any day back to 1999-01-04. It uses the European Central Bank euro reference rates (published on working days around 16:00 CET) and returns the converted amount, the rate, the inverse rate and the actual rate date, for up to 10 target currencies. Rates are indicative mid-market rates, not a bank or card rate, and there is no cryptocurrency. Do not use for crypto, metals or live market quotes.

amount.description: The amount of money to convert, greater than 0 and up to 1e12, with at most 2 decimals. Example: 100.50.

date.description: Optional rate date as YYYY-MM-DD (1999-01-04 or later, not in the future). Example: 2026-10-16. Omit for the latest published rate.

from.description: The ISO 4217 currency code to convert from, e.g. USD.

to.description: One to ten ISO 4217 currency codes to convert to, separated by commas. Example: EUR or EUR,JPY,GBP.

name: convert_currency

additionalProperties.description: Rounded monetary amount as a decimal string to preserve all digits.

title: Convert currency
